15.1 什么是二元期权？
二元期权通常是一种固定结果合约，其结果取决于到期时某一设定条件是否满足。
美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）将二元期权描述为一种全有或全无的投资，其结果取决于到期时的是/否条件。
例如：“BTC/USD 在 12:01:00 是否会高于 100,000？”
用户选择“是”或“否”。合约将在一分钟后到期。
假设：

Underlying:              BTC/USD
Current reference price: 100,000
Proposition:  BTC/USD will be above 100,000 at expiry.
Duration:     1 minute
Stake:        100 USDT
Example payout: 180 USDT total

Scenario A - YES Wins   (Settlement price = 100,250, condition TRUE)
  Stake:   100 USDT
  Payout:   80 USDT
  Total:   180 USDT

Scenario B - YES Loses  (Settlement price = 99,850, condition FALSE)
  Stake:   100 USDT
  Payout:     0
  Loss:    100 USDT

Scenario C - Exact Price (Settlement price = 100,000, tie)
  Predefined tie rule applies, e.g.:
    - Equal = loss
    - Equal = refund
    - Equal = void
该规则必须在交易前予以披露。

zh.title: 20. 关于二元期权的关键监管要点

blocks.text: 不能简单假定一分钟二元产品自动落入立陶宛 MiCA/CASP 牌照的范围。
ESMA（欧洲证券和市场管理局）此前曾对向零售客户营销、分销和销售二元期权实施全欧盟范围的临时禁令。由于许多国家监管机构已采取永久性措施，ESMA 后来于 2019 年 7 月允许该临时措施到期失效。
ESMA 的定义涵盖了这样一类合约：其支付金额仅限于预先确定的固定金额或零，具体取决于与标的相关的预设条件是否满足。
因此，该架构在上线前应设立独立的“二元产品监管边界”。

zh.title: 50. 重要的商业与监管设计原则

blocks.text: 平台不应将上述所有组件作为单一的通用投资方案进行营销。
相反，客户旅程应清楚表明用户正在使用哪一项具体服务。例如：

CRYPTO           -> Crypto asset services       -> MiCA / CASP perimeter
RWA              -> Real-world asset            -> Issuer / SPV / Securities analysis
TRADING          -> Binary / derivative-style   -> Separate regulatory analysis
INHERITANCE      -> LPA-Custodian                -> Custody + succession workflow
DISTRIBUTION     -> Referral / compensation     -> Separate commercial/consumer/jurisdiction review
这一点尤为重要，因为 MiCA 授权并不会自动授权所有可通过加密接口提供的金融产品。

Custody & Compliance Infrastructure

15.1 What Is a Binary Option?
A binary option is generally a fixed-outcome contract based on whether a defined condition is met at expiry.
The CFTC describes binary options as an all-or-nothing investment in which the outcome depends on a yes/no condition at expiration.

blocks.text: The one-minute binary component must not simply be assumed to fall under a Lithuanian MiCA/CASP licence.

Every component of Dynastree (万承) is designed to be a demand driver for the underlying ecosystem, not an isolated feature. Each module gives members a recurring reason to hold, deposit, and transact within the platform, which increases the usage and circulation of the underlying crypto asset over time.
MLM / Distribution CRM
Sponsor and binary genealogy growth continuously onboards new members and packages, expanding the active wallet base transacting in the underlying token.
1-Minute Binary Trading
High-frequency trading activity creates constant buy/sell pressure and settlement flow, driving daily transaction volume through the ecosystem.
RWA Registry & Tokenised Assets
Tokenised real-world assets give holders a reason to keep value on-platform rather than exit to fiat, deepening on-chain liquidity.
LPA-Custodian (族谱连)
Inheritance and succession policies encourage long-term custody of assets within the platform across generations, reducing sell pressure and extending holding periods.
Packages & Trading Points
Package tiers, re-entry rules, and monthly trading points reward continued participation, reinforcing repeat usage and token velocity within the ecosystem.
Custody & Compliance Infrastructure
Institutional-grade custody, KYC/AML, and audit controls build the trust required for larger holders and RWA issuers to commit capital to the ecosystem.

Taken together, distribution, trading, real-world assets, and inheritance custody form a reinforcing cycle: more members and products increase transaction volume and custody depth, which increases demand for and utility of the underlying crypto asset, which in turn strengthens the value proposition for new members and asset issuers joining the ecosystem.

Important Regulatory Qualification

The Lithuanian MiCA/CASP structure is a foundation for applicable crypto-asset services, not a blanket licence for every component described above. The Bank of Lithuania's current MiCA materials describe CASP authorisation and the relevant crypto-asset service framework.

The 1-minute binary product is particularly important to isolate. ESMA's historical EU intervention prohibited marketing, distribution or sale of binary options to retail clients, and national measures remained relevant after the temporary ESMA measure expired. Consequently, the proposed software should implement jurisdiction/product gating from day one rather than assuming that a Lithuanian CASP licence permits the binary product.
Likewise, if an RWA represents a financial instrument, the product needs to follow the relevant securities framework rather than being automatically treated as a MiCA crypto-asset.

In other words: the 80,000 USDT budget builds the technology platform; the final legal entities, licences, product classifications, custody arrangements and jurisdictions determine which modules can actually be activated for customers.
